info.title: OpenAsy Cost API
info.summary: Cloud spend by team and tag, with budgets, forecasts and anomaly alerts.
info.description:
Every screen of cost uses this API, and so can your scripts and pipelines (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

Send spend with `COST_INGEST_TOKEN`. Everything else takes the session of a signed-in person or an API token, and each operation names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003).

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

post.description:
Takes spend lines from a pipeline: a JSON array (or `{ records: [...] }`), NDJSON, or CSV, optionally gzipped, up to 200,000 lines. Each line is `{ date, provider, account, service, amount, currency, region?, resource?, usageType?, tags? }`; in CSV, tags are columns named `tag:team`. A line with the same date, provider, account, service, region, resource, usage type and currency as one that exists replaces it, so a day can be sent again. Lines with the same key in one call are added together. A tag `team` names the owner; otherwise the rules under Rules do.

```bash
aws ce get-cost-and-usage --time-period Start=2026-10-01,End=2026-10-15 --granularity DAILY --metrics UnblendedCost \
  --group-by Type=DIMENSION,Key=LINKED_ACCOUNT Type=DIMENSION,Key=SERVICE Type=TAG,Key=team \
  | node tools/ce-to-records.mjs \
  | curl -sf -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $COST_INGEST_TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @- \
    https://cost.example.com/api/v1/records
```

Takes COST_INGEST_TOKEN, or an API token with the editor role.

Amounts are in the reporting currency. Lines in a currency nobody has set a rate for are left out of the totals and named in `missingRates`.

Needs the viewer role.

Changing the reporting currency drops the rate of the new one, which is worth exactly itself.

Needs the admin role.

put.description:
A team tag on a line wins over every rule. Rules match an account id, a service name (`*` and `?` are wildcards, case does not matter) or a tag value.

Needs the admin role.

post.description:
A monthly amount for a team or a tag, with alerts at 50%, 80% and 100%.

Needs the admin role.

get.description:
A day of one service in one account that cost more than the mean of the 14 days before it plus three standard deviations, and by more than the anomaly minimum.

Needs the viewer role.

200.description: From OPENASY_PRODUCTS, for the product switcher.
Metrics in the Prometheus text format.

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when cost runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the cost origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings → API tokens (`oa_cost_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003).

adminToken.description: Only when cost is started by its tests or a local script: one shared token with the admin role. A production install does not have it.

ingestToken.description: `COST_INGEST_TOKEN`: for pipelines. It can send spend, nothing else.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

id.description: The product, as OpenAsy names it.

url.description: The address people open it at.

forecast.description: Where the month ends if the last seven days' rate holds.

dailyRunRate.description: The last seven days, per day.

previousMonth.description: The whole of the month before.

untaggedShare.description: Share of this month's spend that nobody owns yet, 0 to 1.

budgetsAtRisk.description: Budgets that passed 50% or are forecast to pass 100%.

missingRates.description: Currencies left out of the figures because no rate says what they are worth.

lines.description: Lines kept: those with the same key are added together.

replaced.description: Kept lines that already existed and were replaced.

untagged.description: Spend nobody owns yet. Null when the filter already names a team.

groups.description: Largest first; for day, week and month, in time order.

changePercent.description: Null when there was nothing before.

anomalyMinimum.description: A day must cost this much more than usual, in the reporting currency, to be an anomaly.

rate.description: What one unit is worth in the reporting currency.

match.description: An account id, a service name with * and ? as wildcards, or a tag value.

burnRate.description: Spend against the straight line to the budget: 1 is on pace, above 1 runs out early.

usual.description: The mean of the 14 days before.

nextCursor.description: Pass the previous page's nextCursor to get the next page.
